name: hypersheets-workshop
description: Skills for the Hyper Sheets Workshop. video-promo: a 20-second vertical motion video for the learner's own page, made with HyperFrames 0.9.51 from a template that already renders. motion-kit: a 10 to 30 second vertical video from any short brief, assembled from a kit of ready-made scenes through one storyboard file, with sound effects and, when asked, a spoken voice, so a small model such as Haiku 5.5 is enough.
